2608.22615.title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue
2608.22615.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based counseling agents can generate fluent and supportive responses, but they often lack the structured, goal-directed progression required to conduct a coherent therapeutic session. We present DeepSAGE (Strategic AI Guidance Engine), a hybrid LLM--Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for stage-aware counseling dialogue grounded in the first session of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). DeepSAGE represents the session as eleven stages with explicit therapeutic objectives, with an external controller determines stage completion and the DRL model selects therapeutic intentions that guide LLM response generation. We evaluate DeepSAGE against six retrieval-, prompting-, stage-, and policy-based alternatives. DeepSAGE elicits higher simulated client engagement and openness and achieves the strongest balance of stage-goal completion and dialogue efficiency among stage-structured systems. Domain expert review further indicates that the generated conversations exhibit broadly plausible emotional trajectories and recognizable CBT processes. Because the evaluation relies primarily on simulated clients and model-based metrics, these findings demonstrate comparative dialogue-control improvements rather than clinical effectiveness. These results suggest that combining stage-structured dialogue with learned strategy selection is a promising approach for AI counseling, though clinical effectiveness, safety, and real-world utility require further human evaluation.
2608.22615.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的輔導代理可以生成流暢且支持性的回應，但它們往往缺乏進行連貫治療會話所需的結構化、目標導向的進展。我們提出了DeepSAGE（戰略人工智慧指導引擎），這是一個混合LLM-深度強化學習（DRL）框架，旨在基於認知行為療法（CBT）第一次會議的階段意識輔導對話。DeepSAGE將會議表示為十一個階段，並具有明確的治療目標，外部控制器決定階段完成情況，而DRL模型選擇指導LLM回應生成的治療意圖。我們將DeepSAGE與六個基於檢索、提示、階段和政策的替代方案進行評估。DeepSAGE引發了更高的模擬客戶參與度和開放性，並在階段結構系統中實現了階段目標完成和對話效率之間的最佳平衡。領域專家的評審進一步表明，生成的對話展現出廣泛合理的情感軌跡和可識別的CBT過程。由於評估主要依賴模擬客戶和基於模型的指標，這些發現展示了相對的對話控制改進，而非臨床有效性。這些結果表明，將階段結構對話與學習的策略選擇相結合是一種有前景的AI輔導方法，儘管臨床有效性、安全性和現實世界的實用性仍需進一步的人類評估。
